_about: Push and in-app notification text. Tokens in braces. `setting` is the profile switch that turns it off. Quiet hours hold back push and SMS but not the in-app row.

incoming.title: A pigeon is headed your way
incoming.body: {bird} left {fromCity} with a note from {friend}. Lands {eta}.

landed-in.title: {bird} has landed
landed-in.body: There is a note from {friend} on your sill.

landed-out.title: {bird} delivered your note
landed-out.body: {friend} has it. {distance} in {duration}. You earned {seeds} seeds.

reply-home.title: {bird} is home, with a reply
reply-home.body: {friend} wrote back. It rode home free.

home-empty.title: {bird} is home
home-empty.body: No reply this time. {He} is pretending not to mind.

delayed.title: {bird} is running late
delayed.body: Last seen {lastSeen}. Tap to send a search party.

delayed-in.title: A bird is on the way, eventually
delayed-in.body: {friend}'s pigeon {bird} got distracted. The note is still attached. Probably.

roosting.title: {bird} stopped for the night
roosting.body: Asleep near {place}. Back in the air at first light.

tip.title: {friend} gave {bird} a snack
tip.body: You got {seeds} seeds. {bird} got the snack.

friend-joined.title: {friend} made a loft
friend-joined.body: You can send birds both ways now.

link-expired.title: Your note to {name} came back
link-expired.body: The link was not opened in 7 days.
